title: Business Operations & Finance Assistant
company: Aimee Willow Connex Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Full job description

Take ownership of recurring finance administration and bookkeeping across the commercial finance brokerage delivering complete, accurate and reconciled information to the Finance Director. The role creates capacity for financial review, management information, budgets and forecasting.

Bookkeeping and cost register
- Manage the accounts inbox, respond to routine queries and follow outstanding items through to completion.
- Process invoices through Dext and Xero, allocating them to the correct company, account and tax code.
- Keep bookkeeping current across the group and complete bank and card reconciliations to the agreed timetable.
- Obtain invoices and receipts that require manual collection, including weekly follow-up for missing documents.
- Maintain the cost register across all group companies, including recurring costs, commitments, renewals and changes, with correct company and department allocations.
- Use approved AI tools and established workflows, check their outputs and follow company requirements for handling sensitive information.

Sales & Invoicing
- Raise and send sales invoices to lenders promptly, maintain expected payment dates and coordinate payment chasing with staff.
- Match receipts and remittances to invoices and records; investigate differences and follow up missing information.
- Handle routine lender queries about invoices, payments and remittances, referring matters requiring a decision to the Finance Director.

Expenses and purchasing
- Process staff expense claims, check supporting documents and approvals, chase missing invoices and receipts, and resolve routine queries.
- Manage routine purchasing across the group within agreed budgets and approval limits: obtain quotes where needed, place authorised orders, follow up invoices and receipts, and support card administration.

Accounting, payroll and reporting
Journals and month-end support
- Prepare and post routine manual journals, including revenue-share entries, using agreed calculations and approval processes.
- Prepare month-end adjustments, including accruals and prepayments, and supporting schedules for review.
- Reconcile balance sheet and control accounts; investigate differences and clearly flag unresolved items.
- Record intercompany transactions and reconcile balances across group companies.
- Maintain the fixed asset register and regular depreciation schedules, and prepare VAT returns for review.

Variance analysis and reporting

Canopy and commission reconciliations
- Reconcile Canopy CRM records against Xero, including remittances, commission income, introducer commissions and clawbacks.
- Correct routine finance data errors within agreed permissions, retain an audit trail and escalate system faults or unresolved differences promptly.
- Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual reports by company and department, showing pound and percentage variances against approved budgets.
- Investigate significant differences: check coding, missing costs, accruals and timing, and obtain explanations from relevant staff.
- Provide initial commentary and flag unresolved issues using agreed investigation and escalation thresholds.
- Prepare routine reports and supporting schedules to agreed daily, weekly and month-end deadlines, keeping an organised audit trail.

Essential experience and skills
- Practical bookkeeping experience and confidence using Xero, bank reconciliations and routine journals.
- Experience preparing payroll and supporting pension administration, with a careful approach to checks and deadlines.
- Confidence using spreadsheets to reconcile data, prepare budget-versus-actual reports and investigate differences.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage recurring tasks and follow queries through to resolution.
- Clear, professional communication with colleagues and external contacts, and discretion with financial and payroll information.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
Location: East Manchester
Salary: 30,000- 32,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

Client Details

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated finance professional to take ownership of a varied portfolio of UK and international customer accounts, helping to minimise overdue debt, improve cash flow and maintain strong customer relationships.

You will play an important role in ensuring effective credit control processes, accurate financial records and the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

Description

The key responsibilities of a Credit Controller will be:
- Manage UK and international customer accounts, proactively chasing overdue invoices by telephone and email.
- Monitor aged debt reports, prioritise collections and minimise overdue balances and bad debt.
- Build strong customer relationships, resolving payment queries, disputes and invoice discrepancies.
- Negotiate payment plans and escalate high-risk or long-outstanding debts where necessary.
- Review customer credit limits and manage credit holds in collaboration with internal teams.
- Prepare aged debt, Direct Debit and collection reports, providing regular updates to senior management.
- Allocate daily receipts, investigate unallocated cash and maintain accurate sales ledger records.
- Reconcile customer accounts and process refunds, new account applications, invoices and statements.
- Complete bank reconciliations across six UK, European and US bank accounts and prepare payments in line with company procedures.
- Maintain accurate collection records and ensure compliance with internal policies and financial controls.
- Support the wider Finance team with additional duties as required.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller will have:
- Proven experience in a Credit Controller role.
- Experience managing a high-volume sales ledger and a varied portfolio of customer accounts.
- Demonstrable experience in debt collection, managing overdue balances and resolving complex account queries.
- Strong reconciliation, investigation and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to analyse aged debt reports, prioritise collection activity and manage competing deadlines.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with a confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a wider Finance team.
- Experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly desirable but not essential.

Job Offer
- A salary between 30,000 - 32,000 per annum
- Full time office based working
- Generous annual leave and enhanced pension
- Life assurance
- Local gym membership
- Free on-site car parking
- Employee discounts on products
